alo.quote: Cancellation policy (Dining Room / Kitchen Counter / Parlour Room), quoted verbatim from Alo's own reservations page: "Cancellations and/or party size decreases made less than 72 hours in advance of the reservation will be charged the price of the tasting menu per guest." Private Dining Room: "Cancellations made less than 5 days in advance will be charged for the price of the menu per guest to the credit card on file." Price: Alo's own site does not print tasting-menu dollar figures as static text (prices are shown only inside the Tock booking widget, which this tool could not load). The $185 CAD six-course tasting-menu price is confirmed by a third-party dated review quoting the figure directly: "We reserved for the six-course tasting menu ($185 Canadian or roughly $133 U.S.)" (foodgal.com, 2026). A ten-course tasting menu is separately listed at $245 CAD by tastingmenu.ca, sourced from Alo's own menu listing page; not independently verified against alorestaurant.com static text.

notFound: clo: scarf — no hat/scarf-labelled entry with a stated clo value was found in an accessible copy of ISO 9920 Annex B (only the front matter/table of contents of the standard is available without purchase), in ASHRAE 55's own garment table (confirmed via the pythermalcomfort clo_individual_garments table, which states it is sourced from ISO 9920:2009, and contains no hat or scarf row), or in the McCullough/Havenith peer-reviewed databases reachable without a paywall. The only measured headwear item with a clo value found was a 'Hillside cap 3.0' (0.01 clo) and a 'Biwak cap' (0.03 clo) from a 2021 peer-reviewed ambulance-clothing validation study (PMC7855677); that study has no scarf entry.

alo tasting-menu price on Alo's own static site text — alorestaurant.com's menu and reservations pages describe the tasting menu but do not print its dollar price as static HTML; the price is rendered only inside the third-party Tock booking widget (exploretock.com/alorestaurant), which returned HTTP 403/timeout to this tool. The $185 CAD (6-course) figure used here is instead sourced from a dated third-party review (foodgal.com, 2026) that quotes the exact price Alo charged at booking.
